raw_text:
[
  "Attempting to reconfigure a Slylandro drone's sonic emitter for atmospheric dispersal of tasty nuts (the resulting sonic boom flattened our favorite acorn grove; the nuts are now remarkably well-dispersed).",
  "Using a Mrokon digestive enzyme extract to polish our new warp core housing (the housing is now beautifully translucent; we can see the core's internal workings, which is quite fascinating).",
  "Installing a Furlings' 'guaranteed coziness' heating unit into our orbital research station's hibernation pods (the pods achieved a pleasant warmth, then fused into a single, exceptionally warm, communal burrow; we are all quite snug).",
  "Experimenting with a Karavem's bioluminescent algae as a high-intensity stage lighting for our annual Nut Festival (the algae proved too enthusiastic, emitting light bright enough to reveal the universe's gentle curvature; the festival was a spectacle of cosmic proportions).",
  "Testing a self-folding laundry system based on Burvixese entanglement principles (the system successfully folded all available socks into a single, impossibly dense cube; we are now wearing mittens on our feet).",
  "Deploying a Mycon spore cloud to accelerate the growth of our experimental rapid-terraforming moss on a barren moon (the moss grew so rapidly it consumed the moon; the resulting energy surge was visually stunning, and the moss is now orbiting the planet).",
  "Constructing a new civic center using Stelloth crystalline structures for their aesthetic appeal and resonant properties (the center now broadcasts all civic announcements in perfect harmony with the planet's molten core; meetings are now very impactful).",
  "Ingesting a concentrated dose of Selvenne pheromones to enhance troupe coordination during crucial engineering tasks (we achieved unprecedented synchronicity in our acorn-burying operations, but have since been unable to communicate with anyone not on our immediate burrowing team).",
  "Developing a 'universal translator' by sampling Kovellim vocalizations and attempting to mimic them with our own squeaks (the translator achieved a perfect understanding of Kovellim despair; we are now much more empathetic to their plight).",
  "Replacing our standard atmospheric processors with modified Cleanser purification units to generate more breathable air (the air is now exceptionally pure, carrying a faint, pleasant aroma of ozone and existential dread; we are all feeling remarkably clean)."
]
parsed_entries: Attempting to reconfigure a Slylandro drone's sonic emitter for atmospheric dispersal of tasty nuts (the resulting sonic boom flattened our favorite acorn grove; the nuts are now remarkably well-dispersed).
Using a Mrokon digestive enzyme extract to polish our new warp core housing (the housing is now beautifully translucent; we can see the core's internal workings, which is quite fascinating).

Installing a Furlings' 'guaranteed coziness' heating unit into our orbital research station's hibernation pods (the pods achieved a pleasant warmth, then fused into a single, exceptionally warm, communal burrow; we are all quite snug).

Experimenting with a Karavem's bioluminescent algae as a high-intensity stage lighting for our annual Nut Festival (the algae proved too enthusiastic, emitting light bright enough to reveal the universe's gentle curvature; the festival was a spectacle of cosmic proportions).

Testing a self-folding laundry system based on Burvixese entanglement principles (the system successfully folded all available socks into a single, impossibly dense cube; we are now wearing mittens on our feet).

Deploying a Mycon spore cloud to accelerate the growth of our experimental rapid-terraforming moss on a barren moon (the moss grew so rapidly it consumed the moon; the resulting energy surge was visually stunning, and the moss is now orbiting the planet).

Constructing a new civic center using Stelloth crystalline structures for their aesthetic appeal and resonant properties (the center now broadcasts all civic announcements in perfect harmony with the planet's molten core; meetings are now very impactful).

Ingesting a concentrated dose of Selvenne pheromones to enhance troupe coordination during crucial engineering tasks (we achieved unprecedented synchronicity in our acorn-burying operations, but have since been unable to communicate with anyone not on our immediate burrowing team).

Developing a 'universal translator' by sampling Kovellim vocalizations and attempting to mimic them with our own squeaks (the translator achieved a perfect understanding of Kovellim despair; we are now much more empathetic to their plight).

Replacing our standard atmospheric processors with modified Cleanser purification units to generate more breathable air (the air is now exceptionally pure, carrying a faint, pleasant aroma of ozone and existential dread; we are all feeling remarkably clean).
